title: InterestOpened
description: A coming service or a closed region that people voted for has opened. `user_ids` are the voters who asked to hear and were not told yet; a long list is split across several events with the same target. `name` is the service or region name in every language loads has it in.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

target_key.description: The service code (`taxi`, `parcel`) or the region id.

name.description: The target's name by language code; may be empty.

user_ids.description: Who to tell, at most 500 per event.
